name: A_FETCH_GREYNOISE
description: IP background-noise / scanner reputation via the GreyNoise community API. Input: ip. Stub-safe: when GREYNOISE_API_KEY is unset, prints intent and returns a canned known-scanner result (Censys) so demo flows run offline. On the real path a 404 means the IP has not been seen (noise: false), NOT an error.
